Requirement / Trigger: $22,000 starting cash; choose from six starter vehicles (seven in REMIX).
Design Function: Establishes ownership identity immediately instead of forcing one canonical starter.
First major roster expansion; race participation gates access more than pure money.

Requirement / Trigger: IS300, 57 Bel Air, 300C, Cuevito; later San Diego DUB reward SL55 AMG.
Design Function: Frequent vehicle injections keep category experimentation moving.
Second city doubles as the next performance tier gate.

Requirement / Trigger: Escalade EXT, SS1000 and category-club access/rewards.
Design Function: Rewards are often category-specific, encouraging the player to inhabit different car cultures.
Top purchasable tier arrives before the career finale, leaving room to actually use it.

Requirement / Trigger: Fleetline, Cien, ME Four-Twelve and other club-completion vehicles.
Design Function: Late progression mixes novelty, prestige and outright performance rather than only bigger numbers.
A recognizable prestige car marks championship status.
Completion reward is a collector/status object rather than a prerequisite for finishing.

Requirement / Trigger: Category/class tournaments award REMIX-only vehicles; all tournaments unlock Tokyo police car.
Design Function: Reuses the existing category language as a compact second progression campaign.
